summary: Sony Group Corporation filed a Form 6-K disclosing that its Compensation Committee resolved to introduce a performance share unit (PSU) equity compensation plan for directors (excluding outside directors), corporate executive officers, other officers and employees of Sony and its subsidiaries. The plan replaces stock-option-based grants with PSUs plus continued RSUs, with payouts of 0%-200% of granted units based on three-fiscal-year performance conditions including Total Shareholder Return. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation on a deal, or advisor is involved; this is a routine compensation-governance disclosure with no risk-arb angle.
